contracts: Verification succeeds only when every applicable Consumer has structured successful-enable evidence tied to its real production call surface; it fails if any Consumer is missing, simulated, or unsuccessful.
selector_intents: Select a negative validator path that substitutes a mock, stub, simulated dispatch, or direct state mutation for the Consumer real call surface, and fail when that substitution is accepted.
Select the targeted real-Consumer execution test or probe and fail when any applicable Consumer lacks a production call-surface invocation or successful enable evidence.
